section_summary: This section consists mainly of April 1941 consular telegrams reporting the movements, routes and cargoes of Japanese merchant ships, usually followed by copies paraphrased for the U.S. Navy. It also includes a report on a Japanese ship diverted from Vladivostok to Rashin and February correspondence about transmitting ship movement reports from the Far East.

people.name: Foster
people.role: Consular telegram sender at São Paulo

people.name: Armour
people.role: Diplomatic telegram sender at Buenos Aires

people.name: Cordell Hull
people.role: U.S. Secretary of State; signer of the message to the embassy in Tokyo

people.name: H. D. Bode
people.role: Captain, USN; Head of Foreign Intelligence Branch

subfiles.title: BOSTON MARU sailing
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports the BOSTON MARU's sailing for Singapore.
subfiles.summary: The BOSTON MARU reportedly sailed on April 1 for Singapore.

subfiles.title: NANMAN MARU at Santos
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV and Coast Guard
subfiles.about: Reports the NANMAN MARU's call at Santos and onward route.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived from Montevideo on March 29 and left Santos on April 3 for Yokohama via Ceará, the Panama Canal and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Bills of health for NAGARA MARU and VENICE MARU
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Lists bills of health granted to two Japanese vessels bound for New York.
subfiles.summary: The NAGARA MARU and VENICE MARU received bills of health for routes to New York through American and Panama Canal ports.

subfiles.title: HAGUE MARU and EIYO MARU at Singapore
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports arrivals and departures of two Japanese ships at Singapore.
subfiles.summary: The HAGUE MARU departed toward Calcutta on April 4; the EIYO MARU sailed for Yokohama on April 5.

subfiles.title: SANUKI MARU at Buenaventura
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports the SANUKI MARU's voyage from Buenaventura to Arica.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived April 3 and sailed April 4.

subfiles.title: TUYAMA MARU at Antofagasta
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports the TUYAMA MARU's brief Antofagasta call.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Balboa and sailed for Valparaíso on April 4.

subfiles.title: NAKO MARU cargo and route
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports the NAKO MARU's cargo and planned departure from Tampico.
subfiles.summary: After arriving in ballast from Baltimore, the ship planned to sail via the Panama Canal and Los Angeles with 6,700 tons of lead, zinc and antimony reportedly destined for Japan.

subfiles.title: HEIYO MARU at Valparaíso
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports the HEIYO MARU's departure for Hong Kong.
subfiles.summary: The vessel arrived from Arica on April 2 and sailed via Los Angeles on April 5.

subfiles.title: HEIEI MARU No. 7 and TEIYO sailings
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports departures toward the Philippines and Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: HEIEI MARU No. 7 sailed for José Panganiban on April 2; the tanker TEIYO sailed for Los Angeles on April 3.

subfiles.title: KIMIKAWA MARU at Valparaíso
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports the KIMIKAWA MARU's route to Kobe.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Arica on April 2 and left Valparaíso on April 7 via Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Bills of health for HEIAN MARU and TAKAOKA MARU
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Lists bills of health and routes for two Japanese ships.
subfiles.summary: HEIAN MARU was bound for Seattle via Vancouver; TAKAOKA MARU for the Panama Canal Zone through West Coast ports.

subfiles.title: NAGARA MARU and VENICE MARU departures
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports both vessels sailing for New York on April 4.
subfiles.summary: NAGARA MARU sailed via Los Angeles and the Panama Canal; VENICE MARU via San Francisco, Los Angeles and the canal. A corrected Navy copy identifies Yokohama as the telegram's origin.

subfiles.title: Navy charter of KOKUYO MARU
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports a Japanese Navy chartered tanker bound for San Francisco.
subfiles.summary: The KOKUYO MARU was due to leave Kure on April 6 to load oil and gasoline, carrying 47 regular crew and 15 Japanese naval personnel.

subfiles.title: NOSIRO MARU at Barranquilla
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports the NOSIRO MARU's arrival and planned route to New York.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived from Cristóbal on April 8 and was to depart via Curaçao and La Guaira on April 9.

subfiles.title: YAMABIKO MARU at Buenos Aires
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports the YAMABIKO MARU's departure for Kobe.
subfiles.summary: The ship left Buenos Aires on April 8 via Montevideo, Santos, the Panama Canal and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: TUYAMA MARU at Valparaíso
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports the TUYAMA MARU's onward route to Hong Kong.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Antofagasta on April 7 and sailed via Los Angeles on April 9.

subfiles.title: HEIAN MARU and KOGYO sailings
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports two April 5 sailings.
subfiles.summary: HEIAN MARU departed for Vancouver and Seattle; KOGYO was reported sailing for Sydney and Melbourne.

subfiles.title: YAMABIKO MARU at Montevideo
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports the YAMABIKO MARU's arrival and planned departure.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Buenos Aires on April 9 and was due to sail for Santos, the Canal Zone, Los Angeles and Kobe on April 11.

subfiles.title: PENANG MARU and ATLAS MARU at Singapore
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports arrivals and intended departures of two ships.
subfiles.summary: PENANG MARU arrived from Miki and was bound for Tuticorin; ATLAS MARU arrived from Sabang and was bound for Kobe via Shanghai and Keelung.

subfiles.title: ARIMA and TAKAOKA departures
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports April 7 departures for Los Angeles and South America.
subfiles.summary: ARIMA sailed for Los Angeles; TAKAOKA sailed for South America's west coast via San Francisco, Los Angeles, Manzanillo and Balboa.

subfiles.title: SAKITO MARU at Manzanillo
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports the SAKITO MARU's cargo discharge and intended sailing.
subfiles.summary: Arriving from Los Angeles on April 11, it was to discharge 608 tons of general cargo and sail for Valparaíso via the Panama Canal.

subfiles.title: SANUKI MARU at Valparaíso
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports the SANUKI MARU's departure for Hong Kong.
subfiles.summary: The Navy copy clarifies that the ship arrived from Arica on April 9 and departed via Los Angeles on April 12.

subfiles.title: NOSIRO MARU at La Guaira
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports the NOSIRO MARU's call at La Guaira.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Curaçao on April 12 and was due to leave directly for New York that evening.

subfiles.title: TOA MARU departure from Montevideo
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports the TOA MARU's planned route toward Kobe.
subfiles.summary: The ship was due to leave April 13 via Buenos Aires, Rio de Janeiro, Santos and the Panama Canal.

subfiles.title: Japanese steamer diverted from Vladivostok
subfiles.to: American Embassy, Tokyo
subfiles.about: Relays a Vladivostok report about a Japanese steamer's cargo discharge at Rashin.
subfiles.summary: Unable to unload at Vladivostok, it sailed to Rashin and discharged 2,300 tons of unspecified cargo.

subfiles.title: SEIWA arrival at Makatea
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports the Japanese flagged SEIWA's arrival at Makatea.
subfiles.summary: SEIWA arrived from Miike on April 11.

subfiles.title: TOA MARU at Santos
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports a prior Santos call by the TOA MARU.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Rio de Janeiro on April 8 and left for Buenos Aires on April 9.

subfiles.title: NAN MAN MARU at Fortaleza
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to Navy
subfiles.about: Reports the NAN MAN MARU's call and onward route.
subfiles.summary: The ship came from Santos, called April 10–13, and left for Japan via the Panama Canal, Los Angeles and San Francisco.

subfiles.title: AKAGI MARU at Peruvian ports
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports the AKAGI MARU's movement from Mollendo to Tambo de Mora.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived April 11 and departed April 13.

subfiles.title: KIMIKWA MARU at Antofagasta
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports the KIMIKWA MARU's call and sailing for Mollendo.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived from Caldera on April 11 and sailed for Mollendo at midnight on April 13.

subfiles.title: NORWAY MARU and MATUE departures
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports one confirmed and one reported April 9 departure.
subfiles.summary: NORWAY MARU sailed for South America's west coast via San Francisco, Los Angeles and Balboa. MATUE was reported to have sailed for Calcutta.

subfiles.title: Bills of health for six Japanese vessels
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Lists bills of health and routes for six Japanese merchant ships.
subfiles.summary: The telegram names HOKKAI, NORWAY, MEXICO, AWATA, YAWATA and NIPPON MARU. Routes include New York, the Panama Canal Zone, Davao and West Coast ports; NIPPON MARU was to load oil and gasoline at San Pedro.

subfiles.title: AWATA, HOKKAI, YAWATA and HABURG sailings
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to Navy
subfiles.about: Reports three departures and one reported sailing on April 10.
subfiles.summary: AWATA and HOKKAI sailed for New York via Los Angeles and the Panama Canal; YAWATA headed toward Honolulu and California. HABURG MARU reportedly sailed for Calcutta.

subfiles.title: MANZYU MARU tanker departure
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports a tanker sailing from Moji to Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: The roughly 6,000 ton MANZYU MARU, owned by Asahi Sekiyu Kaisha, sailed on April 9.

subfiles.title: HAVANA MARU departure from Bombay
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports the HAVANA MARU's route to Japan.
subfiles.summary: The ship sailed on April 11 via Singapore and Shanghai.

subfiles.title: HEIYO MARU at Peruvian ports
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; for Navy
subfiles.about: Reports the HEIYO MARU's movement from Cerro Azul to Huacho.
subfiles.summary: It arrived April 13 and departed April 14.

subfiles.title: Cover memorandum on Far East ship reports
subfiles.from: H. D. Bode, Office of Naval Intelligence
subfiles.to: Orme Wilson, Department of State
subfiles.about: Seeks State Department approval of a proposed reporting method.
subfiles.summary: Bode encloses the proposed Navy communications memorandum.

subfiles.title: Proposed transmission of Far East ship movement reports
subfiles.to: Director of Naval Communications
subfiles.about: Proposes routing foreign flag merchant ship reports through naval radio at Cavite.
subfiles.summary: The proposal seeks to reduce Navy Department traffic beginning March 1.

subfiles.title: TATSUTA MARU, ERIE MARU and KANJYU sailings
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports departures for Manila, Batavia and Haiphong.
subfiles.summary: TATSUTA MARU sailed for Manila on April 12; ERIE MARU was reported sailing for Batavia that day and KANJYU for Haiphong on April 13.

subfiles.title: SANUKI MARU at Antofagasta
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports the SANUKI MARU's call and departure for Peruvian ports.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Coquimbo on April 16 and sailed that evening for Tocopilla and Peru.

subfiles.title: Four Japanese ships at Singapore
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports arrivals and departures of four Japanese merchant ships.
subfiles.summary: AKEBONAI MARU sailed for Kobe, MANILA MARU for Moji, HAKODATE MARU for Calcutta via Penang, and ANYO MARU for Moji, after recent arrivals from Dairen, Sabang, Saigon and Bombay respectively.

subfiles.title: SEIWA departure from Papeete
subfiles.to: Secretary of State; forwarded to OPNAV
subfiles.about: Reports the SEIWA's sailing for Japan.
subfiles.summary: The Japanese flagged ship sailed on April 15.
